summary: Iter15 pre-launch smoke complete. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (SEO assets, products/plans/blog/leads APIs, admin login + 401 + auth-required + product PUT round-trip + status filter). Frontend: Home loads cleanly in EN+KA, KA toggle persists across reload (sp-lang=ka), WhatsApp FAB href = wa.me/995591969901, signup modal opens via header CTA, catalogue/food shows 216 products with filters, FAQ/Plans/Blog routes render, admin login → /admin/products dashboard loads with tab-drafts + tab-published + 100+ product rows. Two route/data inconsistencies found around the new Legal Pages — see backend_issues + frontend_issues.

minor.issue: STATIC_SITEMAP_PATHS in server.py advertises /delivery and /refund, but the SPA routes are /delivery-policy and /refund-policy (App.js L60-61). Crawlers hitting the sitemap URLs receive the React SPA 404 fallback — bad for SEO. Fix: update server.py STATIC_SITEMAP_PATHS to /delivery-policy and /refund-policy (or add redirect routes).

ui_bugs.issue:
data-testid='delivery-intro' and 'refund-intro' never render in DOM. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/data/legalContent.js DELIVERY (L377) and REFUND (L451) objects have no `lead` field, and LegalPages.jsx L62-64 wraps the

inside `{doc.lead && (...)}`. PRIVACY (L20) and TERMS (L213) DO have a `lead` field — privacy-intro and terms-intro render correctly in both EN and KA. Fix: either add a `lead` field to DELIVERY/REFUND in legalContent.js, or change LegalPages.jsx L62 to always render the

using intro/lead as fallback so the testid is always present.

Review request expects /delivery and /refund routes, but App.js routes are /delivery-policy and /refund-policy. Both /delivery and /refund currently render the SPA 404 page (visible '404 — This page doesn't exist'). Footer correctly links to /delivery-policy and /refund-policy, so the public site is internally consistent, but external links (sitemap, marketing collateral) using the spec'd URLs will 404. Decision needed: rename routes to /delivery and /refund, or accept the longer slugs.

(LOW / informational) Signup modal opens correctly from the header CTA. Empty-submit validation didn't surface visible .error elements; browser native validation may be in play. Not blocking deploy but worth a manual eyeball before launch.
critical_code_review_comments:
LegalDocument component (LegalPages.jsx L51-100) renders the lead paragraph conditionally on doc.lead, but the data-testid contract requires it to always be present. Make the testid contract independent of content presence — either always render the

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid for launch. The two outstanding issues are scoped to the new bilingual Legal Pages batch: (1) delivery-intro / refund-intro testids never render because the data file is missing the lead key, and (2) the route names /delivery and /refund advertised in the sitemap and the review spec don't match the actual SPA routes /delivery-policy and /refund-policy. Both are 5-minute fixes for E1. After the fix, re-run only the legal-pages portion of the playwright check (the rest of the smoke suite is green).
rca of the issue:
delivery-intro/refund-intro RCA: In /app/frontend/src/data/legalContent.js, the PRIVACY (L20) and TERMS (L213) objects expose a `lead` key with EN+KA strings. DELIVERY (L377) and REFUND (L451) do NOT define `lead`. In /app/frontend/src/pages/LegalPages.jsx L62, `{doc.lead && (

...

)}` short-circuits to null when doc.lead is undefined, so the testid never reaches the DOM. Repro: open /delivery-policy, run document.querySelector('[data-testid="delivery-intro"]') in DevTools → null. Mitigation: add `lead: { en: '...', ka: '...' }` to DELIVERY and REFUND, or change L62 to `

{doc.lead ? renderInline(pickLocale(doc.lead, lang)) : null}

` (always render the wrapper). /delivery & /refund 404 RCA: App.js routes the bilingual legal pages at /privacy, /terms, /delivery-policy, /refund-policy. server.py STATIC_SITEMAP_PATHS lists /delivery and /refund (without -policy). The SPA's catch-all renders the 404 page for those URLs.
